text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! As if you could ever
defeat me in sheer skill!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Raw skill, huh? Sure, you might have me beat
in that department. But—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Who cares about that?!
As long as I win right now!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —What!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(That's right. We don't have to win every time.
We ain't something that grand.)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Just a single moment! A reckless, desperate run that shines brighter than anyone else for just one fleeting instant!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That is how our generation runs!
Even if only for a moment, it's no illusion!!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOH?!
Impossible, my wall!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here comes Jungle Pocket on the prowl!
Jungle Pocket attacks!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A clash of pure pride between the strongest Umamusume!
The victor is—Jungle Pocket!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A "blaze of light"—broke through the wall.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The canopy of absolute dominion that covered the Twinkle Series for two years—
was shattered by Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Ooh, the strongest is—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: It's meeee!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the strongest of the generation, to the strongest active runner!
It might be a miracle born from the alignment of several lucky factors. Even so――

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Jungle Pocket stands at the pinnacle of all generations right now!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A miracle born from a coincidence of favorable conditions, perhaps.
However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Defeated by an Umamusume surging up from the younger generation...
Me... of all people...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Is this a falling curtain as well? Can't you hear it, Doto...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Guiding us to the throne of the gods,
the bells of Lakmé chime.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*... Opera... O...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You're totally beat, Pokke-san.
Hardly surprising, though.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Because with that tender, youthful body and spirit of yours,
you managed to defeat me."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Right now, it is still a miracle.
Yet, after witnessing that miracle time and time again,
people will come to realize that she is a king.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The strongest—is you, Pokke-san.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Opera O... you...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I've grown slightly bored.
With predictable victories. The twilight of the heart inevitably comes.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I—we shall transform the theater.
And waiting there...
will be those who have become gods.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me this is it for you...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Never mind me. I can see my own battlefield.
More importantly, how about you? What about your future?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Do you understand? What it truly means
for the End-of-Century Overlord to ascend the throne of God...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (No good... I've got zero energy left, my brain's not working. Besides...)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(I've never really understood
what this guy is saying anyway...)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, it's like this. Dawn doesn't come
immediately after dusk. No, what comes next is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
First comes the "Dusk."
I pray it brings a wonderful era.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Opera... O...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, with an utterly exhausted body,
she somehow managed to finish the Winning Live—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
My bad, Trainer...
After pulling off such a big feat, I went and collapsed on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Despite being in her Classic Year, she defeated none other than T.M. Opera O. Considering how grueling it was, it was only natural."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I won, all right.
Still hasn't really sunk in yet, though.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What did I do? What happened? What's going to happen to me now? Not a single clue...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
For now, what should our next goal be?
That's about all we can decide on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"About our next race.
I've been thinking it over from various angles, but..."
choice_data_list: You probably shouldn't push yourself too hard for the rest of the year.
Maybe you shouldn't overdo it for the rest of the year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Originally, I had planned to target either the Japan Cup or the Arima Kinen after the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: In that case, the next chance will be next year...
choice_data_list: Shall we start with the "Hanshin Daishoten"?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The Hanshin Daishoten... A 3000m GⅡ, huh.
Which means the obvious next target is—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: It's the Tenno Sho (Spring), then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A prestigious 3,200m GⅠ.
To solidify your position as the strongest,
it is one of the races you must challenge.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Understood. Then for now...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Just let me sleep for now.
Just for tonight...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having accomplished an extraordinary feat,
Jungle Pocket collapsed onto the beat-up sofa, and—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking ahead to next year's Hanshin Daishoten, I fell into a light sleep.
